minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, June 19th, 2024

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 19th, 2024.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Jenny Jolly, and Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: Terry Kistler, George Borst.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, May 15th, 2024 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 25 participants per week
  in May.

  Meals on Wheels: Update.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through June 19th, 2024 was
  $39.00 Deposit of $260.00. The average attendance for May/June was 41
  players per week.

5. Account Balance: $2,483.65.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for May except for Bingo.

7. MT. SAC Classes: May 9th was registration for summer/fall classes. Mt. Sac
  classes will be partnering with the city for fee-based classes. The classes include
  children’s cooking, wine tasting, and adult tap dancing.
 8. Aging Next: 5 La Verne residents were served in May.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Aquatic Center is open. Veterans Hall is getting its floor
  redone/finished in the Main Hall. Looking into possible Live Oak Pickleball
  courts by turning one tennis court into 4 pickleball courts.

10. Upcoming Events:

  •  Friday, June 21st – Senior Seminar: Know the Scams, Don’t be a Victim – Los Angeles Department of
  Mental Health, 9:30 AM.
  •  Sunday, June 30th – Concerts in the Park: Scattered Dreams (80’s), 6:30PM.
  •  Thursday, July 4th – Fourth of July.
  • Pancake Breakfast: 6:30-10:30 AM.
  • Parade: 10:00AM.
  • Fireworks: Gates open at 6:00PM for 7:00 PM show.
  •  Monday, July 8th – Movie Matinee: Still Alice, 12:30 PM.
  •  Wednesday, July 10th – Senior Seminar: Reverse Mortgage – Longbridge Financial, 9:30 AM.
  •  Friday, July 12th – Excursion: Medieval Times Dinner and Tournament, 3:15-9:00 PM.
  •  Sunday, July 14th – Concerts in the Park: Upstream Music (Reggae), 6:30PM.
  •  Sunday, July 21st – Movie Night at the Park: Kung Fu Panda 4, 8:15PM.
  •  Tuesday, July 23rd – Excursion: Nixon Library and Brea Mall, 9:00 PM-4:30 PM.
  •  Friday, July 26th – Senior Seminar: Tablets and Smartphones Basics – Independence at Home, 9:30
  AM.
  •  Sunday, August 4th – Movie Night at the Park: Elemental, 8:15PM.
  •  Tuesday, August 6th – Excursion: Aquarium of the Pacific and a Cruise, 9:00 PM-4:00 PM.
  •  Tuesday, August 6th – National Night Out, 4:30-7:30PM.
  •  Monday, August 12th – Movie Matinee: TBD, 12:30 PM.

  Public Comments: Congratulations to Terry and Edward on their awards.
  Yvonne Duran is working on the budget for Community Services. Pre-
  school will be wrapping up soon. The high school graduation on June 6th
  will cause the streets to be very crowded. Durward will be sectioned off for
  the Graduation. The Community Center and City Hall will be closing at
  4:00PM on that day. George Borst stated that Senior Gold league broke a
  twenty-three-year-old jinx by getting a hole in one. Bette Donovan,
  researching the costs of paper, pencils, and prizes for bunko.

11. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:36AM. The next meeting will be held
  on Wednesday, August 21st, 2024 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:

  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
